The shared wrapper captures only after all original windows, CPU endpoints, validation, archives and final live guard check. No capture call runs within a measured window.

Final validation exceptions save failure.json with all original results, attempt task-only STOP, preserve any stop error and raise before complete.json. Existing slot restoration and original failure handling remain.
The imported health helper is hash-checked before startup and recorded in identity; final private tool copies and the author verifier match their declared bindings.
